title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：volcano　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 volcano 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the ranger ① studyed the volcano that no villager in the valley would have noted, and he said the studying was the whole of the season. The ② volcano, meaning the mountain itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed unnoted in the book; a volcano, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ volcano in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ volcano at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A volcano, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the ranger said the noting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the volcano was the whole of the matter, meaning the threat and not the mountain. The ⑥ volcano, meaning the threat and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; volcano, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a mountain and a threat. He said the threat is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ volcano had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ volcano of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of noting; volcano, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ volcano I remember is the mountain noted in the survey, which closed in 1981 and is still noted as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ volcano, my mother said in 1983, is the only mountain that improves by being noted; every volcano, she said, is a threat that has agreed to look like a mountain. She said the threat was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 火山（指山谷里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 火山（指那座火山本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the volcano 考察这一座火山
D. n. 火山（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 火山之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的火山之事）
F. n. 火山（指踏勘记录里写到、被记下的那一座）
G. n. 火山、隐患（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 隐患（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studyed the volcano that no villager in the valley would have noted
The volcano, meaning the mountain itself and not the staff
the volcano at the far ridge
the volcano was the whole of the matter
the volcano had become a line in a survey
The volcano of the whole thing
A volcano, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: study the volcano 意为“考察这一座火山”，1974 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯记下的一座火山做了一遍。
volcano 意为“火山”，指那座火山本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被记下。
volcano 意为“火山”，指山谷里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
volcano 意为“火山”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
volcano 意为“火山、隐患”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座隐患就是那件事的全部。
volcano 意为“隐患”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座火山，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
volcano 意为“火山”，指踏勘记录里写到、被记下的那一座，到 1979 年这一座成了踏勘记录里的一行。
volcano 意为“火山之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的火山之事是一处山谷和三个季节的记下。
volcano 意为“火山”，我记得的是踏勘记录里记下过的那一座，1981 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一座。
volcano 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，火山是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的火山。
